title: Reading Practice Test 03 – Food & Restaurants
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: phiếu giảm giá, e-mail, bài báo có chèn câu, đoạn kép). Chủ đề: nhà hàng, nhà cung cấp thực phẩm, lớp nấu ăn.

questions.content: The restaurant's new menu features dishes made with ------- grown vegetables.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho phân từ 'grown' (được trồng) → 'locally grown' = trồng tại địa phương.

questions.content: Reservations are recommended, ------- walk-in guests are also welcome.
questions.explanation: Hai vế đối lập (nên đặt trước – nhưng khách vãng lai vẫn được đón) → 'but'.

questions.content: The chef ------- at the Riverside Bistro for ten years before opening her own café.
questions.explanation: Hành động kéo dài xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ (before opening) → quá khứ hoàn thành 'had worked'.

questions.content: Customers can choose ------- a soup or a salad with every lunch special.
questions.explanation: Cặp liên từ 'either … or' = hoặc … hoặc. 'both' đi với 'and'; 'neither' đi với 'nor'.

questions.content: All kitchen staff are required to wash their hands ------- before handling food.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'wash' → trạng từ 'thoroughly' (kỹ lưỡng).

questions.content: The catering company is known for ------- high-quality meals at reasonable prices.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ 'for' dùng V-ing → 'providing'.

questions.content: Mario's Pizzeria will extend ------- opening hours during the summer festival.
questions.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu đứng trước cụm danh từ 'opening hours' → 'its'. Lưu ý 'it's' = it is.

questions.content: The food critic described the dessert as the most ------- she had tasted all year.
questions.explanation: So sánh nhất 'the most + tính từ' → 'impressive'.

questions.content: Please inform your server of any food ------- before ordering.
questions.explanation: Sau 'any food' cần danh từ (food allergies = dị ứng thực phẩm) → 'allergies'.

questions.content: The café's profits increased ------- after it started offering delivery services.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'increased' → trạng từ 'significantly' (đáng kể).

groups.passage:
Fresh Start at Olive & Thyme

After three months of renovations, Olive & Thyme will reopen on Friday, October 4. Our dining room has been ---131--- to seat 80 guests, and we have added a private room for special events.

Chef Marco Bellini has also created a new seasonal menu. ---132---. Every dish is prepared with ingredients from farms within 50 miles of the restaurant.

To celebrate our reopening, all diners will receive a free dessert during the first week. ---133---, guests who make a reservation through our Web site will be entered into a drawing for a dinner for four.

We look forward to ---134--- you soon!

questions.explanation: Bị động hoàn thành 'has been + V3' (phòng ăn đã được mở rộng) → 'expanded'.

options.A: It includes several vegetarian and gluten-free options.
options.B: The renovation cost more than expected.
options.C: Our staff will be on vacation next week.
options.D: Parking is available on Elm Street.

questions.explanation: Câu trước giới thiệu thực đơn mới, câu sau nói về nguyên liệu → câu chèn phải mô tả thực đơn: có món chay và không gluten.
Câu sau nêu thêm một ưu đãi nữa (bốc thăm bữa tối) → 'In addition'.
'look forward to' – 'to' là giới từ → theo sau là V-ing 'serving'.

groups.passage:
GREEN BOWL SALAD BAR

Buy one bowl, get the second at half price!

Valid Monday through Thursday, 11:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M.
Offer expires November 30. Cannot be combined with other discounts.
Present this coupon when ordering. One coupon per customer per visit.
Available at all Green Bowl locations except our airport store.

questions.content: When can the coupon be used?
questions.explanation: Chỉ áp dụng thứ Hai–thứ Năm, 11:00–15:00 → thứ Ba lúc 12 giờ trưa hợp lệ. (D) quá giờ.

questions.content: What is indicated about the offer?

options.A: It can be combined with other discounts.
options.C: It applies to all menu items.
options.D: It is not accepted at one location.

questions.explanation: 'Available at all Green Bowl locations except our airport store' → không áp dụng ở một cửa hàng.

groups.passage:
To: orders@freshfieldfarms.com
From: owner@lemongrassbistro.com
Date: May 14
Subject: Change to weekly order

Dear Freshfield Farms,

I am writing to update our standing weekly order, which is delivered every Tuesday. Beginning next week, please increase our order of basil from two boxes to four. Our new summer menu features several dishes that use fresh basil, and they have become very popular.

Also, please remove the red peppers from our order. We have found a supplier closer to the restaurant who can deliver them daily, which keeps them fresher.

Finally, I noticed that last week's invoice charged us for three boxes of lettuce, but we received only two. Could you please check this and send a corrected invoice?

Thank you,
Priya Nair
Owner, Lemongrass Bistro

questions.content: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
questions.explanation: 'I am writing to update our standing weekly order' – standing order = đơn đặt hàng định kỳ.

questions.content: Why does Ms. Nair want more basil?

options.D: It is an ingredient in popular new dishes.

questions.explanation: 'Our new summer menu features several dishes that use fresh basil, and they have become very popular.'

questions.content: What problem does Ms. Nair mention?

options.D: Some basil was out of stock.

questions.explanation: Hoá đơn tính 3 thùng rau diếp nhưng chỉ nhận 2 → hoá đơn sai.

groups.passage:
Food Trucks Find a Permanent Home
By Alan Brooks, Staff Writer

PORTLAND – For years, food trucks in Portland had to move from street to street in search of customers. That changed last spring, when the city opened the Harbor Food Court, a covered lot where up to twelve trucks can park permanently. [1]

The court has been a success. Weekend visitors often wait in line for thirty minutes or more, and several truck owners report that their sales have doubled. [2] "Having a fixed location means our regular customers always know where to find us," said Jenna Cho, who sells Korean-style tacos.

Not everyone is pleased, however. Some nearby restaurant owners say the court has drawn customers away from their businesses. [3] The city council plans to review the project in December before deciding whether to open a second site. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.D: A permanent site for food vendors

questions.explanation: Bài báo nói về Harbor Food Court – nơi đỗ cố định cho xe bán đồ ăn.

questions.content: According to the article, what has happened to some truck owners?

options.B: They have moved to other cities.

questions.explanation: 'Several truck owners report that their sales have doubled' → doanh số tăng mạnh.

questions.content: The word "drawn" in paragraph 3, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'drawn customers away' = thu hút khách hàng đi nơi khác → attracted. 'sketched' là nghĩa 'vẽ' – bẫy.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"The trucks pay a monthly fee that covers electricity, water, and security."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn mô tả thêm về khu Harbor Food Court vừa được giới thiệu (xe đỗ cố định trả phí hằng tháng) → vị trí [1].

groups.passage:
Taste Academy – June Cooking Classes

• Italian Pasta Basics – Wed., June 5, 6:00–8:30 P.M. – $65
• Thai Street Food – Wed., June 12, 6:00–8:30 P.M. – $70
• Knife Skills for Beginners – Sat., June 19, 10:00 A.M.–12:00 P.M. – $45
• French Pastry Workshop (croissants and tarts) – Sat., June 26, 1:00–5:00 P.M. – $95

All ingredients and equipment are provided. Participants take home any food they prepare. Classes are limited to 12 people. Cancellations made at least 72 hours before a class receive a full refund.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: info@tasteacademy.com
From: d.moreau@mailbox.com
Date: June 8
Subject: Class registration

Hello,

I signed up for the Thai Street Food class, but I just learned that I have to travel for work that week. Since the class is still more than 72 hours away, I understand I can get a full refund. However, I would prefer to transfer my registration to another class instead.

I work during the day on weekdays, so an evening or weekend class would be best. I have always wanted to learn how to make croissants, so if there is still space, I would like to join that class. I am happy to pay the difference in price.

Best regards,
Denise Moreau

questions.content: What is stated about the classes?

options.A: Participants must bring their own equipment.
options.B: They are designed for professional chefs.
options.C: Participants can take home what they cook.

questions.explanation: 'Participants take home any food they prepare.' (D) sai – tối đa 12 người.

questions.content: Why did Ms. Moreau write the e-mail?

options.C: To switch to a different class

questions.explanation: 'I would prefer to transfer my registration to another class instead.' (A) là bẫy – cô biết được hoàn tiền nhưng không muốn.

questions.content: What is indicated about the class Ms. Moreau originally registered for?

options.B: It is held in the morning.

questions.explanation: Cô đăng ký lớp Thai Street Food; theo lịch lớp này giá $70, học buổi tối.

questions.content: Which class does Ms. Moreau most likely want to join?
questions.explanation: Cô muốn học làm croissant, lớp buổi tối hoặc cuối tuần → French Pastry Workshop (thứ Bảy 26/6, dạy croissant).

questions.content: How much more will Ms. Moreau most likely pay?
questions.explanation: Chênh lệch giữa lớp mới ($95) và lớp cũ ($70) là $25 – cô đồng ý 'pay the difference in price'.
